text.label: Text
text.info: Ink. Body copy, headings, and primary buttons.

accent.label: Accent
accent.info: Link hover, progress bars, and the focus ring. Must stay readable on the page background.

signal.label: Sale
signal.info: Used only for sale prices and the sale badge. Keeping it rare is what makes it read as a signal.

heading_scale.label: Heading size
heading_scale.info: Scales every heading level at once. Sizes stay fluid between mobile and desktop.

caption_letter_spacing.label: Caption letter spacing
caption_letter_spacing.info: Applies to small uppercase labels, including the material tag.

page_gutter.label: Page margin
page_gutter.info: Horizontal space between page content and the edge of the screen.

corner_radius.label: Corner radius
corner_radius.info: Applies to buttons, inputs, cards, and media.

show_seam_dividers.label: Show seam dividers
show_seam_dividers.info: A dashed hairline between sections instead of a solid rule.

enable_reveal.label: Reveal sections on scroll
enable_reveal.info: Always disabled for visitors who have reduced motion turned on.

card_hover_image.label: Show second image on hover
card_hover_image.info: Uses the second image on the product. Products with one image are unaffected.

card_show_material.label: Show material tag
card_show_material.info: Reads the product metafield custom.material. Hidden when the metafield is empty.

cart_free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping threshold
cart_free_shipping_threshold.info: In your store currency, without a currency symbol. Set to 0 to hide the progress bar.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.info: Will be scaled down to 32 x 32px.

share_image.label: Social sharing image
share_image.info: Used when a page without its own image is shared. 1200 x 630px works best.

brand_description.label: Brand description
brand_description.info: Used as the fallback meta description and in the Organization structured data.

social.name: Social media
social.info: Links appear in the footer and in structured data. Leave a field empty to hide it.

demo.name: Demo content
demo.paragraph: The theme ships with demo photography so a new store looks finished before you upload anything. Turn this off once you have added your own images.

demo_images.label: Use demo images as placeholders
demo_images.info: Only applies where you have not set an image yourself.

enable_sticky.label: Stick to the top of the screen on scroll
